name: Hans Odde
occupation: First deputy Park County clerk; clerk-elect taking office in January 2027 (official clerk page and Powell Tribune, Mar. 24, 2026)
prior_offices: Hot Springs County clerk, three elected terms, 2003–2014 (Powell Tribune, Mar. 24, 2026)
background: Hans Odde is the Park County clerk-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Colleen Renner, who announced she would retire at the end of her current term. The county's official clerk page lists him as first deputy clerk. The Powell Tribune reported in March 2026 that he has served as first deputy in Park County since January 2015, that he previously served three elected terms as Hot Springs County clerk from 2003 to 2014, and that before entering county work he managed a retail store and later briefly headed marketing for an engineering firm in Cody. The paper reported that he finished second in a five-person Republican primary the first time he ran in Hot Springs County and defeated the incumbent four years later. He was unopposed in the November 3, 2026, general election.
